title: Core Evaluation Module
summary: This module provides the foundational components for online evaluation, including configuration, dataset generation, and the mechanisms to run and dispatch evaluators for functions and agents.

nodes.label: Online Evaluation Configuration
nodes.title: OnlineEvalConfig
nodes.description: Manages global and default settings for online evaluations, including sinks, sampling rates, OTel event emission, and error handling. Provides a decorator to enable evaluation for functions.

nodes.label: Agent Online Evaluation Capability
nodes.title: OnlineEvaluation
nodes.description: An agent capability that integrates online evaluators into agent runs. It dispatches evaluators asynchronously after each completed agent run, allowing for non-blocking evaluation of agent outputs.

nodes.label: Evaluation Dataset Definition
nodes.title: Dataset
nodes.description: A Pydantic model defining the structure of evaluation datasets, including test cases, inputs, outputs, metadata, and associated evaluators. Used for both generation and execution of evaluations.

nodes.label: LLM-Powered Dataset Generation
nodes.title: generate_dataset
nodes.description: Generates synthetic evaluation datasets using a Large Language Model (LLM). It constructs prompts based on a target schema and parses the LLM's output to create structured test cases.

nodes.label: Function Online Evaluation Wrapper
nodes.title: online.wrapper
nodes.description: A decorator that enables online evaluation for any Python function. It captures function inputs and outputs, samples relevant evaluators, and dispatches them asynchronously for execution.

nodes.label: Run & Collect Evaluator Results
nodes.title: _run_and_collect
nodes.description: Executes a single online evaluator, manages its concurrency, attaches OpenTelemetry context, emits OTel events for results and failures, and collects outcomes for batch processing.

nodes.label: Batch Evaluation Results to Sink
nodes.title: _submit_group_to_sink
nodes.description: Submits a batched group of evaluation results to a configured `EvaluationSink`. It handles potential errors during submission, routing them to individual evaluator error handlers.

nodes.label: Asyncio Event Loop Management
nodes.title: get_event_loop
nodes.description: Utility function to retrieve the current asyncio event loop or create a new one if no loop is running. Ensures asynchronous operations can be dispatched correctly.

nodes.label: Execute Task within Run Context
nodes.title: _run_once
nodes.description: Executes a given task (e.g., an agent call) within a dedicated task run context. It captures the task's output, duration, and associated OpenTelemetry span tree for detailed evaluation.

nodes.label: Agent Core Module
nodes.title: agent_core
nodes.description: Provides core agent functionalities, including agent definition, execution, and interaction with models and tools. Integrates with evaluation capabilities.

nodes.label: Models & Embeddings Module
nodes.title: models_and_embeddings
nodes.description: Manages various AI models and embedding providers, used for generating responses and embeddings. Utilized by agents and dataset generation processes.

nodes.label: Evaluator Types Module
nodes.title: evaluator_types
nodes.description: Defines various types of evaluators, including base classes and common evaluators like LLM judges, used to assess the performance and quality of AI outputs.

nodes.label: Reporting & Telemetry Module
nodes.title: reporting_and_telemetry
nodes.description: Handles the generation of evaluation reports and telemetry data, often consuming results from evaluators for visualization and analysis.

nodes.label: Large Language Model
nodes.title: LLM
nodes.description: An external Large Language Model used by the `DatasetGenerator` to create synthetic test cases based on provided schemas and instructions.

nodes.label: OpenTelemetry System
nodes.title: OpenTelemetry
nodes.description: An external observability framework used for emitting traces, metrics, and logs, including detailed evaluation events from the online evaluation process.

nodes.label: External Evaluation Sink
nodes.title: Evaluation Sink
nodes.description: An external system or service configured to receive batched evaluation results for storage, further processing, or reporting.

groups.label: Surface API
groups.title: User-Facing Evaluation Interfaces
groups.description: Components that users directly interact with to enable and configure online evaluations for functions and agents.

groups.label: Data Management
groups.title: Evaluation Data Structures & Configuration
groups.description: Components responsible for defining the structure of evaluation data and managing the overall configuration of the evaluation process.

groups.label: Generative Tools
groups.title: Dataset Generation
groups.description: Components that leverage external models to generate synthetic datasets for evaluation purposes.

groups.label: Analytical Core
groups.title: Core Evaluation Logic
groups.description: Components that perform the actual execution, collection, and submission of evaluation results, including task observation.

groups.label: Utilities
groups.title: Helper Functions
groups.description: General utility components supporting asynchronous operations within the evaluation framework.
